00007| **In version 15, we recommend using [`connection`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/connection) instead of `unstable_noStore`.**
00008| 
00009| `unstable_noStore` can be used to declaratively opt out of prerendering and indicate a particular component should not be cached.
00010| 
00011| ```jsx
00012| import { unstable_noStore as noStore } from 'next/cache';
00013| 
00014| export default async function ServerComponent() {
00015|   noStore();
00016|   const result = await db.query(...);
00017|   ...
00018| }
00019| ```
00020| 
00021| > **Good to know**:
00022| >
00023| > - `unstable_noStore` is equivalent to `cache: 'no-store'` on a `fetch`
00024| > - `unstable_noStore` is preferred over `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` as it is more granular and can be used on a per-component basis
00025| 
00026| - Using `unstable_noStore` inside [`unstable_cache`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/unstable_cache) will not opt out of static generation. Instead, it will defer to the cache configuration to determine whether to cache the result or not.
00027| 
00028| ## Usage
00029| 
00030| If you prefer not to pass additional options to `fetch`, like `cache: 'no-store'`, `next: { revalidate: 0 }` or in cases where `fetch` is not available, you can use `noStore()` as a replacement for all of these use cases.

00034|

00039| }
